summary: Full backend (29 pytest cases, real Neon Postgres via public URL) + frontend E2E (Playwright desktop/mobile/tablet) of ICEPOPS shop + seller dashboard. Nearly everything works: signup/login/logout, menu/category/search/add-to-cart, product detail, cart quote (first-order, SCOOP10 incl. min/max cap, free delivery threshold, stacking on/off, Wednesday BOGO via temp weekday override), checkout (zone PIN validation blocks 400001, payment methods by fulfilment, online disabled), idempotency, concurrent first-order (3 parallel → only 1 discounted), inventory decrement/restore (verified in DB), cancel restores first-order eligibility, order isolation (404/401), admin transitions incl. invalid ones (400), reject needs reason, record payment, refund only if paid, audit log, promotions UI save, non-admin 403 / redirect, CSRF 403, forgot/reset. Failures: per-email login lockout does not block a correct password; PUT /api/cart race → 500; minor UI issues.

critical.issue: Per-email brute-force lockout is ineffective: rate_limit('login-fail:<email>') is only evaluated AFTER a wrong password. After 5 failures the 6th wrong attempt returns 429, but a CORRECT password still returns 200 during the lockout window, so an attacker just keeps guessing and the right guess succeeds (only the 20/15min per-IP limit applies). Fix: check the per-email counter before verifying the password (e.g. peek count >=5 → 429 for any attempt), and only append on failure.

minor.issue: Race condition → 500 Internal Server Error (IntegrityError carts_user_id_key / uq_cart_variant) seen 4x in backend.err.log. Two concurrent PUTs for same user both try to create the Cart row / insert the same cart_items. Root cause on frontend: CartContext.jsx line 43-46 calls api.put('/cart') INSIDE a setItems updater function (React StrictMode double-invokes updaters → 2 parallel PUTs), plus debounced persist overlapping. Fix backend with INSERT ... ON CONFLICT / SELECT ... FOR UPDATE on cart (or catch IntegrityError and retry) and move the side effect out of the setState updater.

If a one-time offer was consumed by a parallel checkout, the second order is silently placed at full price (quote shown to the user had the discount). Consider rejecting with 409 when the computed total differs from a client-supplied expected_total so the customer can review.
For a cancelled UNPAID order allowed_transitions includes 'refund_pending', so the UI shows 'Start refund' which then fails with 400. Filter refund_pending when payment_status != 'paid'.

All order emails during testing were recorded 'failed: rate_limited' (Emergent email API returned 429 after ~13 accepted sends). Not an app bug (high test volume), but no retry exists — consider a retry/backoff for outbox rows.

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking 'Mark all read' on /notifications the bell badge still shows the old count (6) until the 30s poll; Notifications page doesn't refresh the navbar unread state.
'Start refund' button shown for cancelled orders with payment 'Not charged' (backend rejects).
After Place order, /orders/<n>?placed=1 opened scrolled to the bottom (scroll position kept from checkout); the placed banner/timeline is off-screen. Add scroll-to-top on navigation.

issues: Uses native <input type=datetime-local> instead of a shadcn date/time picker
When coupon is invalid (min order not met) the button still says 'Remove' and the input stays filled — fine, but the error could be clearer about the current eligible amount

action_items: HIGH: Fix per-email login lockout so correct password is also rejected while locked (routes/auth.py login)
Fix PUT /api/cart concurrency 500 (upsert/lock + move api.put out of setItems updater in CartContext.jsx)
Scroll to top on route change (order detail after placing order)
Refresh navbar unread count after 'Mark all read'
Hide/omit refund_pending transition for unpaid orders
Optional: replace native datetime-local with shadcn picker; consider email retry on 429
critical_code_review_comments: core/security.py rate_limit is in-memory per process — resets on restart and not shared across workers; fine for single worker MVP but document/move to DB/redis for production
rate_limit for orders is applied before the idempotency check, so legitimate retries of the same key consume the order quota
routes/auth.py login: login-ip limit counts successful logins too (20/15min per IP) — shared NAT/office IPs or a busy admin could get locked
CartContext.jsx: side effect (api.put) inside a state updater function is an anti-pattern (double-invoked under StrictMode)
Tests must be run with -n 0 (classes share module fixtures/STATE)

rca of the issue: Login lockout: routes/auth.py line 100-102 calls rate_limit('login-fail:'+email) only in the failure branch, so success path never checks the counter. Repro: 5 wrong logins → 6th wrong = 429 → correct password = 200. Cart 500: concurrent PUT /api/cart for same user; select-then-insert Cart and delete-then-insert CartItems are not serialized → unique violations; triggered by CartContext login merge firing duplicate PUTs.
